items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Johnny Hodges was in the band before he went with Duke. He was in that band.

ctx.x: Johnny Hodges was in the band before he went with Duke. He was in that band. He and Elmer Williams on sax. And Slats Slattery, Johnny Truehart was on guitar, Slats was on trombone, with me and Louis Bacon. And Chick on the drums. And Kirkpatrick was on piano, yeah, Kirk. Nice little band.

And then the Savoy was nice, just opened, nice, nice, Of course, I left there before it got rough and rowdy. Still Sundays, I had that little band down at Ed Small's. See, those men -- we didn't need any music, they knew everything. And my inspiration had been from -- maybe -- there was a band out in Memphis called the Memphis Five. Years and years ago.
